title: Enabled plugin gopls-lsp (manifest defined in marketplace.json, strict:false) logs 'plugins: no manifest' and is skipped
observed: kiln defect (parity, minor). gopls-lsp@claude-plugins-official is enabled in settings. Its install dir has only LICENSE and README.md. The plugin is declared in the marketplace's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with strict:false and lspServers.gopls. kiln logs WARN 'plugins: no manifest' for it and ignores it. Other no-manifest warnings in this run came from disabled plugins whose directories were not copied into the scratch HOME (environment, not kiln).
expected: Read the marketplace entry for strict:false plugins as Claude Code does, or skip such plugins without a warning since kiln has no LSP support anyway.
